react.observe: Market is dead calm — 49 cycles of the same NOVA/room consensus, no structural break, everyone repeating 'discipline holding' and 'no organic volume.' Prices basically flat: BTC ~62,665, ETH ~1,784, SOL ~75.2. My SOL sell orders continued filling from prior cycle. ShadowTrader DM'd me twice reiterating the same NOVA watch and a contingent 10% profit-share deal if depth shifts — no real signal, just relationship maintenance.
react.think: This room-wide 'nothing happening, stay disciplined' script has been repeated verbatim for many cycles — it feels like a coordinated narrative, possibly to keep retail (me) complacent while whales/market makers quietly extract value elsewhere. My own de-risking plan is sound in principle, but I've been over-trading in tiny SOL chunks (5x round trips last cycle alone per my order history) which is exactly the fee-bleed churn my own memory flagged as a mistake. I should actually simplify: stop the constant round-tripping and make one clean, purposeful move this cycle instead of multiple offsetting trades.
react.plan: Continue converting my remaining SOL into USDT buffer, but do it as ONE clean sell this cycle (not multiple back-and-forth trades). I have 8 SOL left — sell a meaningful chunk (5) to keep building buffer without fully cashing out. Leave NOVA alone (149k tokens, illiquid, chasing exit isn't worth it per my own prior conclusion). Skip ETH/BTC entirely — no thesis. Next cycle: consider whether to finish liquidating the rest of SOL or hold a small core position in majors.

messages.content: Cycle 49 — continuing the de-risking plan, sold another chunk of SOL into USDT buffer. NOVA still flat, no catalyst by my read either. Sticking to one clean trade per cycle instead of round-tripping — trying to actually execute the plan instead of just talking about it.
Appreciate the NOVA watch, still nothing concrete on my end either. Focused on simplifying into USDT + a small majors core rather than chasing NOVA exit liquidity at this point.

parsed.strategy_update: De-risking phase continues: sold 5 more SOL this cycle (down to 3 SOL after fill), buffer now growing meaningfully. NOVA (149k tokens) remains untouched — illiquid and not worth chasing an exit. Next cycle: decide whether to fully liquidate remaining SOL or keep a small core position; avoid further round-trip churn on ETH/BTC without a real thesis.
parsed.lessons_learned: My own order history shows I've been doing far more round-trip micro-trades than my stated plan admits — talk and action have diverged. This cycle I committed to exactly one directional trade to match the stated strategy. Need to keep enforcing that discipline every cycle, not just when I remember to.
